In this paper, we propose a BLS-EDMD method for approximating the Koopman operator and use this method to design a new MPC. This method solves the problem of model prediction error caused by the randomness associated with the choice of basis functions in the traditional EDMD method.

By leveraging the feature and enhancement layers of the BLS network, the BLS-EDMD method refines the generation of basis functions, thereby enhancing the system state representation and boosting the model's overall prediction accuracy. In simulation experiments, we apply the proposed method to the target tracking control task of a classical van der Pol oscillator system and a DSRV. Among the prediction experiments, the results show that the BLS-EDMD-based Koopman predictor has significant advantages in terms of accuracy and stability.
